caption: The drawing depicts a small drawstring bag positioned vertically on a plain, light beige background. The bag is composed of two distinct sections: the upper section is made of a shiny, black material gathered at the top with a braided black drawstring threaded through metal eyelets. The lower section of the bag is decorated with a beadwork design, exhibiting a floral pattern in varying shades of blue and light blue on a predominantly black beaded background. The floral motifs are evenly distributed, covering the entire beaded portion of the bag. At the bottom edge of the beaded area, there is a fringe made of black beads that dangles down uniformly. In the lower right corner, the drawing is signed "James McNeill Whistler."
title: Beaded Bag
